title: nyxloom archived-document lifecycle frontmatter
description: Frontmatter carried by every file under docs/archive/product-docs/ (CR-01, DR-04). historical = no current successor covers the concern; superseded = a named current authority replaced it.

superseded_by.description: Repo-relative path of the current authority that replaced this document. Required iff status=superseded; forbidden for status=historical (no fake successor).
